id: title:jakesciotto:surface webhook read failures in the ui

review.posthog_relevance: Warehouse webhook status retrieval and credential sanitization
review.reason: Adds a fallback status object and an error message when webhook status retrieval fails, while also adding a test asserting that the returned error does not expose the secret.
review.uncertainty: The tier is assigned based on the presence of a substantive implementation and a corresponding test, but the review cannot independently verify the actual runtime behavior or the complete implementation context, relying solely on the supplied hunk descriptions. No unverified outcomes are inferred.

observations.limitations: Only supplied hunk IDs are cited. No score assigned.

observations.behavior: Adds a fallback status object and an error message when webhook status retrieval fails, while also adding a test asserting that the returned error does not expose the secret.
observations.posthog_connection: Provides a safe, non-sensitive error response when PostHog cannot read a warehouse webhook, preventing credential leakage while allowing the UI to report a failure state.

observations.behavior: Adds a unit test that mocks the webhook retrieval to raise an exception and asserts the response status and the absence of the secret in the returned error message.
observations.posthog_connection: Validates that the implementation correctly sanitizes sensitive secret information from error messages returned to the user.
